reasons: The candidate multiplies the result by the constant 100, which does not appear in the Datadog source. Hard rules forbid numeric constants absent from the source; any unit scale should go in notes with a documentation link, not in promql.

The OTel metric container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes has an interface attribute. avg by (container_name) averages across interface series, while the Datadog query has one series per container, so the aggregation and series set differ unless interfaces are collapsed explicitly.
Grouping by container_name is supported: the label is observed in the dataset. The scope template variable has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct.
The rate() over a monotonic sum is consistent with a bytes counter, but whether Datadog docker.net.bytes_sent is a per-second rate or a raw count should be confirmed before accepting the unit.
